scope: All 21 authorized Cipher Museum recommendations; existing Crypto Lab demos linked, not recreated. Selected passages in13 works, not whole-book certification.

items.change: Corrected keyboard/plaintext-tape, cipher attachment, radio ciphertext and receiving plaintext path.

items.validation: Three-task chronology cross-checked against report/book passages; narrow table accessible by scrolling.

items.change: Explained branch number, dispersion and the individual four-round trail bound; linked AES Anatomy.

items.change: Added exact static DES S1 differential/key-filter examples and linked Biham Lens.
items.validation: Independent full S1 DDT enumeration and two-observation intersection {17,23}; exposed-component boundary retained.

items.title: Separate DES attack resource measures
items.change: Separated historical DES collection, retained data, analysis work and access variants.
items.validation: Displayed exponents, phase labels, structure arithmetic and probabilistic/access caveats checked.

items.title: Show all 26 Caesar scores
items.change: Extended existing Caesar lessons with all 26 scores, evaluated path, stopping point, score optimum and supplied-answer markers.
items.validation: Independent score table; actual run/edit/restore/empty-input controls; escaped input; desktop/mobile checks.

items.change: Added the 256-bit mixture comparison: about129 Shannon bits versus aboutone min-entropy bit and half-success first guess.

items.title: Explain privacy amplification and its limits
items.change: Added eight-row partial-leakage/XOR example and a parity-leakage failing control.
items.validation: Every displayed row checked; conditional parity independence and failing control enumerated.

items.title: Separate authenticity from freshness
items.change: Added valid-tag/freshness A/B/A, tampered-counter and receiver-reset worked cases; linked Regex Veil.
items.validation: Independent real HMAC and receiver-state calculation for every row; ordered-delivery limits explicit.

items.title: Demonstrate ambiguous hash inputs
items.change: Added ambiguous tuple bytes and specified UTF-8 byte-length encoding; linked Context Ward.
items.validation: Exact bytes/digests, empty/separator/non-ASCII inputs and malformed decoding checked; no false collision claim.

items.title: Explain purpose-separated HKDF outputs
items.change: Added exact HKDF Extract/Expand fixtures, direction labels and prefix comparison; linked KDF Chain.
items.validation: PRK/output recomputed independently using HMAC and Node/OpenSSL HKDF; all bytes visible on mobile.

items.validation: All small mask/shift outcomes and rejected-edge control enumerated; no standard signer or security proof claimed.

items.change: Explained KEM outputs, reencryption, deterministic implicit rejection and separate size validation; linked KEM Trap.
items.validation: Conceptual text compared with verified source algorithms; existing toy remains explicitly nonstandard.

items.change: Added prime-modulus, finite-field-rank q-ary construction and tiny rectangular example; linked existing lattice labs.
items.validation: Lattice membership, determinant, minimum distance, unique recovery, tie and representative-change checks.

items.validation: Hand-countable XOR/count table and strict threshold boundary; historical tape-rate units kept distinct.
